reuse.why: Calls the shared applyWeekendRule that getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and schedule-template already use, plus recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule/parseDate.

duplication.why: No weekend logic is duplicated; only the RSchedule try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold is repeated from getUpcomingDates, as is usual in this file.

placement.why: Handler lives next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in the same way, with the rule kept in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short, with a named constant explaining the window widening, and weekend changes stay in one helper.
